summary: Five open issues, all written by the weekly refactor scan. Three of them are one refactoring told in three parts and should sit under a parent; one is not pickup-ready; the board has no issue at all for Step 12c.

findings.title: Extract and adopt EventConsumerBase is one user story, not three issues
findings.detail: All three describe the same outcome: the Centers stop each carrying their own copy of the consumer scaffold. Filed separately, whoever picks up #37 has to discover #36 first.
findings.suggested_title: Consolidate the Center consumers onto one shared scaffold
findings.suggested_body:
The four Centers each carry their own consumer loop, outbox dispatcher, and progress bookkeeping. Consolidate them behind one shared base so a fix lands once.

- [ ] #36 — extract EventConsumerBase
- [ ] #37 — migrate the three consumers onto it
- [ ] #34 — de-duplicate RemoteOutboxDispatcher

Done when no Center defines its own copy of the scaffold and `dotnet test` is green.

findings.title: #37 cannot start before #36 lands
findings.detail: #37 migrates the consumers onto EventConsumerBase, which #36 creates. The board does not say so, so #37 looks independently grabbable.

findings.title: #25 has no acceptance criteria and does not name the callers to migrate
findings.detail: The issue says to extract shared config helpers but not where they should live or which call sites move. Two people would produce two different PRs.
findings.suggested_body:
Extract the repeated `IsTrue` / `IsFalse` / `ParseInt` / `ParseRate` helpers into one place shared by the Centers.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] The helpers live in `src/DuckNet.Kernel` and no Center defines its own copy
- [ ] Every existing call site uses them
- [ ] `dotnet test` is green

findings.title: Step 12c has no issue on the board
findings.detail: The roadmap's next step is the first live Azure environment, and the whole board is refactoring. Nothing tracks the deploy work.

evidence.detail: Step 12c is the next planned step
templates exist but nothing applies them

findings.title: #38 may already be done
findings.detail: The duck_progress bookkeeping looks like it was already pulled into a shared helper.

evidence.detail: a shared progress helper appears to exist

notes: Every open issue came from the refactor scan; no human has filed one. Worth noticing as a fact about the board, not a defect.
